title: The Effects of Demographic Instructions on LLM Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Krippendorff's alpha agreement between LLM zero-shot sexism classifications and human annotations disaggregated by the human annotators' gender (male vs. female), both with and without explicit gender-based persona instructions in the prompt.

Calculating Krippendorff's alpha agreement between LLM zero-shot sexism classifications and human annotations disaggregated by the human annotators' age groups (18-22, 23-45, 46+), both with and without explicit age-based persona instructions in the prompt.
